| description = Patrols the ruins near Cabilis entrance for approx. 12 minutes, then parks near zone-in to Cabilis for about 5 minutes before moving again.

This means he can be hostile to players on good terms with the Legion of Cabilis (Cabilis guards).  Agnostic Enchanters using Illusion: Iksar are KoS with Quarg but not with Bodli by default, so be wary of him if you are turning in bone chips.
